confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on a few web searches of cost-of-living aggregators, travel guides and a nightlife guide. The sources did not fully agree. One 2026 aggregator-based guide gave a mid-range dinner for two at about $15, which seems implausibly low, so I set that anchor using a 2023 figure of about $30 plus inflation and July peak-season pricing on the seafront. Inexpensive meals ($6-10), cappuccino ($2-3) and beer ($2-3) were fairly consistent across sources; I used the upper part of each range for July. I found no aggregated cocktail price, so the cocktail anchor is estimated from the beer price and typical Albanian coastal bar pricing. The wine anchor comes from one undated nightlife guide that gave 300-600 ALL per glass. Accommodation anchors are general model estimates for July peak season and do not come from searches or live listings. Saranda's seasonal swing is large, so accommodation is the least certain part.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mainly Albanian Riviera and Adriatic resort towns such as Vlore, Durres and Ksamil, and coastal Montenegro at somewhat lower prices. Saranda is reported to be about 20% more expensive than the Albanian average and well above inland towns, especially in July.
